technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Move gpfdist module from spring-xd-modules to core – requires refactoring dependencies and build configuration (Maven/Gradle) to integrate into the existing Spring XD core project, maintaining backward compatibility.

U2: Implement a centralized module registry backed by a GitHub repository – use the GitHub API (REST) to list, upload, and synchronize modules; design will include caching to reduce API calls and handle authentication via OAuth tokens.

U3: Benchmark RabbitMQ on Rackspace – develop automated benchmark scripts using existing Spring XD test harnesses; provision Rackspace infrastructure (or simulate) and measure throughput and latency with varying numbers of xd-container nodes.
U4: Improve Flo parser endpoints – modify existing REST endpoints to return more detailed error messages and stack traces; ensure consistent error response format.

U5: Add SSL/TLS support to Mail source – extend the Mail source configuration to accept java-mail-properties; implement validation for required properties and provide documentation on secure connection setup.
U6: Default to HDFS for custom module registry – change default property in configuration files; modify YARN distribution build to remove custom-modules.zip artifact; update documentation.

U7: Auto-configure shell against environment – implement logic to read environment variables (like AMBARI_HOST, NAMENODE) or use a well-known configuration file; add startup scripts to set admin config server and Hadoop namenode automatically.

U8: Graceful shutdown of streams – add a shutdown hook that waits for in-flight messages to complete before stopping the stream; coordinate with stream lifecycle management (e.g., using a countdown latch or state tracking).
assumptions: The development is performed on an existing Spring XD (or Spring Cloud Data Flow) codebase with standard Maven/Gradle build and continuous integration setup.
The developer has prior experience with the Spring XD codebase, Java 17+, Spring Framework 6.x, and relevant subprojects (e.g., Spring Integration, Reactor).
Each user story effort includes analysis, coding, unit tests, integration tests, and basic documentation updates within the story scope.
External dependencies (e.g., GitHub API, Rackspace infrastructure) are available and accessible; no significant delays for provisioning.
U3 benchmark effort assumes setting up test scripts and running them, not long-term monitoring or production deployment.
Effort does not include code review by others, project management overhead, or deployment to production; it is pure development work.
No major architectural changes are required beyond the scope of these stories; the codebase is modular and supports the changes.

activities.activity_name: Implement U1: Move gpfdist module to core
activities.activity_description: Move the gpfdist sink module from spring-xd-modules repository to the core Spring XD repository. Refactor dependencies, update build files, and ensure compatibility with existing tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement U2: Centralized module registry in GitHub
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a module registry service that uses a GitHub repository as backend. Includes GitHub API integration, caching, authentication, and REST API endpoints for upload and list operations.

activities.activity_name: Implement U3: Benchmark Rabbit on Rackspace
activities.activity_description: Develop automated benchmark scripts to test RabbitMQ performance on Rackspace infrastructure. Provision test environment, run benchmarks with varying numbers of xd-container nodes, and produce a report.

activities.activity_name: Implement U4: Improve Flo parser error reporting
activities.activity_description: Enhance existing Flo parser REST endpoints to provide clearer error messages and consistent error response structure. Includes changes to parser code and endpoint handlers.

activities.activity_name: Implement U5: Mail source with SSL/TLS support
activities.activity_description: Add capability to configure the Mail source with java-mail-properties for secure IMAP/SMTP connections. Implement validation, update configuration schema, and add integration tests with a mock mail server.

activities.activity_name: Implement U6: Default HDFS for custom module registry
activities.activity_description: Change default configuration to use HDFS as the remote location for custom module registry. Remove custom-modules.zip from YARN distribution and update build scripts accordingly.

activities.activity_name: Implement U7: Shell auto-configuration against environment
activities.activity_description: Implement logic for the Spring XD shell to automatically detect and configure admin server URL and Hadoop namenode from environment variables or a predefined configuration file. Add startup script support.

activities.activity_name: Implement U8: Graceful shutdown of streams
activities.activity_description: Add mechanism to allow streams to complete in-flight message processing before shutdown when undeploying. Implement a shutdown hook that waits for pending operations (e.g., archive extraction) to finish.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all user stories together, fix any cross-story issues, and update overall project documentation (README, configuration guides).
